BiblicalUsage: Bichri means youthful, and his name is remembered because of his son. In 2 Samuel 20:1 Sheba the son of Bichri blew a trumpet and said, we have no part in David, and in 2 Samuel 20:2 every man of Israel went up from after David and followed him. In 2 Samuel 20:21 a wise woman of Abel tells Joab that Sheba's head will be thrown over the wall, and the rebellion ends.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bichri's name survives as a warning: a father's name can be carried into a rebellion, and a son's trumpet can split a kingdom.
